context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure commerce provider integration, including how the CommerceProvider is initialized with vendureProvider and how useCommerce is re-exported. Focuses on whether the package's pre-built provider configuration is used rather than a custom one.

checklist.name: Import vendureProvider
checklist.description: The solution imports `vendureProvider` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` and uses it (not a manually constructed object) when initializing the provider.

checklist.name: Use CommerceProvider
checklist.description: The solution imports and renders the `CommerceProvider` component from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` to wrap children, not a generic React context provider.

checklist.name: Re-export useCommerce
checklist.description: The `useVendureCommerce` hook calls or re-exports `useCommerce` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure`, not from `@vercel/commerce` directly.

checklist.name: Correct children prop
checklist.description: The layout component accepts and passes `children` through to `CommerceProvider` correctly, enabling the provider to wrap child components.
